acquisition_time.description: UTC acquisition timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g. '2026-06-12T14:30:00+00:00'). Optional — not recorded when omitted.

data.description: Recorded data for this track; may be omitted for a transmit-only track.

data/attenuation_map/coordinates.description: Per-pixel Cartesian positions (x, y, z) in metres.

data/attenuation_map/description.description: Free-text description of the map contents.

data/attenuation_map/gamma.description: Power-law exponent of the frequency dependence alpha(f) = alpha_0 * f**gamma. 1.0 is linear (soft tissue ~1-1.5, e.g. liver ~1.14), 2.0 for water.

data/attenuation_map/labels.description: Labels for each channel in values.

data/attenuation_map/start_time_offset.description: Time offset between the first transmit event of the ultrasound acquisition and frame 0 of this map. Negative means frame 0 was acquired before the first transmit event; positive means it was acquired after.

data/attenuation_map/timestamps.description: Per-frame acquisition timestamps relative to frame 0.

data/attenuation_map/unit.description: Physical unit of the map values, e.g. 'm/s', '%'.

metadata/credit.description: Credit or attribution for the dataset.

metadata/ecg/start_time_offset.description: Time offset between the first transmit event of the ultrasound acquisition and sample 0 of this data. Negative means this data starts before the first transmit event; positive means it starts after.

metadata/ecg/timestamps.description: Explicit sample timestamps relative to sample 0.

metadata/probe_pose.description: Sampled probe pose at the transducer tip.

metadata/probe_pose/rotation.description: Orientation associated with the transducer-tip pose in the x-lateral, y-elevation, z-axial coordinate convention, interpreted according to rotation_representation.

metadata/probe_pose/rotation_representat.description: Rotation parameterization: one of euler_xyz, quaternion_wxyz, or quaternion_xyzw.

metadata/probe_pose/start_time_offset.description: Time offset between the first transmit event of the ultrasound acquisition and sample 0 of this data. Negative means this data starts before the first transmit event; positive means it starts after.

metadata/probe_pose/timestamps.description: Explicit sample timestamps relative to sample 0.

metadata/probe_pose/translation.description: Position of the transducer tip, ordered as (x, y, z), where x is lateral along the transducer, y is elevation (out of plane), and z is axial (depth).

metadata/subject/genetic_strain.description: Genetic strain (inbred line) of an animal subject, e.g. C57BL/6N.

metadata/subject/id.description: Subject ID. Needed for subject-wise splits.

metadata/subject/type.description: Subject type, e.g. human, phantom, animal.

metadata/text_report.description: Free-text report associated with the study.

metadata/voice_narration/start_time_offs.description: Time offset between the first transmit event of the ultrasound acquisition and sample 0 of this data. Negative means this data starts before the first transmit event; positive means it starts after.

metadata/voice_narration/timestamps.description: Explicit sample timestamps relative to sample 0.

metrics/coherence_factor.description: Coherence factor; ratio of coherent to incoherent energy (0-1).

probe/element_height.description: Height (elevation aperture) of a single transducer element.

probe/element_width.description: Width of a single transducer element.

probe/lens_sound_speed.description: Speed of sound in the acoustic lens.

probe/probe_center_frequency.description: Probe nominal centre frequency (midpoint of the probe's -6 dB band).

probe/probe_geometry.description: Element positions (x, y, z) per element, shape (n_el, 3).

scan.description: Scan acquisition parameters for this track; required when raw_data is present in data, or when data is omitted.

scan/center_frequency.description: Center frequency of the transmit pulse.

scan/focus_distances.description: Transmit focus distances. Positive = focused, negative = diverging (virtual source behind the array), np.inf = plane wave (preferred; 0 is also accepted).

scan/initial_times.description: A/D converter start times per transmit.

scan/rx_aperture_indices.description: Probe element index for each receive channel of the channel data, shape (n_tx, n_rx). Required to interpret the channel axis when the receive aperture is a subset of the probe. Omit it when every element receives, where the mapping is the identity.

scan/tx_apodizations.description: Transmit apodization per element, in [-1, 1]. 0 = element did not contribute, 1 = full contribution, negative = fired with opposite polarity.

transmit_only.description: Whether this track records only the transmit sequence with no corresponding receive data (e.g. a shear wave push pulse or therapeutic ultrasound).
